demos.name: Federated Identity LAB
demos.description: Federated Identity (platform-issued short-lived tokens, exact issuer, subject and audience binding, enforced lifetimes, key-set refresh, a key owned by an identity, revocation) and Self-Hosted Agents (a Kubernetes sensor verified from its token, enforcement modes): a simulation of the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims with real local RS256 verification. Mock tables, or a Live local engine. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7400). Docker: HOST_PORT=7400 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock and Live are both loopback-only with zero outbound calls; all issuers and keys live in memory and nothing is fetched from the network.
